lines.en: label secondbeach13:
scene nikiami1
: ...and so that’s the story of how Ayane got kicked out of Taco Bell!
lines.zh: : ……所以，这就是 Ayane 被赶出 Taco Bell 的来龙去脉！

lines.en: : Yeah...that sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听着确实像她会干的事。

lines.en: : Forgive me, but I’m a bit lost. I’m not seeing the connection between elephants and affordable (By commoner standards)
lines.zh: : 恕我愚钝，我有点跟不上了。我看不出大象和平价（按平民的标准）之间有什么联系。

lines.en: : That’s exactly it, Touka! Those two things have nothing to do with one another.
lines.zh: : 就是这个意思，Touka！这两件事八竿子打不着。

lines.en: : It’s just Ayane being Ayane, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概就是 Ayane 本色出演吧。

lines.en: : The Amamiya family sure uses their wealth in a different way than my own.
lines.zh: : Amamiya 家花钱的方式，和我家还真是大不相同。

lines.en: scene nikiami2
: Why, I recall a time not too long ago when I was craving nourishment. My father had an entire restaurant airlifted all the way to me just to satisfy those needs.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想起前不久的一件事，当时我馋得不行，父亲为了填饱我的肚子，让人把一整家餐厅空运过来给我。

lines.en: : You mean like...some kind of helicopter DoorDash or something?
lines.zh: : 你是说……某种直升机版 DoorDash 之类的？

lines.en: : Heavens, no. I mean the entire restaurant. And, come to think of it, that time was last night.
lines.zh: : 天呐，不是。我说的是一整家餐厅。而且仔细想想，那件事就发生在昨晚。

lines.en: : Is that funny by your standards, Ami? I’m attempting to mimic lower middle class humor by telling mildly amusing stories that people from all walks of life can relate to.
lines.zh: : 按你们的标准，这算好笑吗，Ami？我正试着模仿中下层阶级的幽默，讲一些各行各业的人都能产生共鸣、稍微有点意思的小故事。

lines.en: scene nikiami3
: Wait...why just me? Karin counts as a commoner too, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 等等……为什么只问我？Karin 也算平民吧？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I’ve only just met her, so I didn’t want to assume she had less money than she actually does and wind up offending her.
lines.zh: : 恐怕是因为我刚认识她，不想贸然断定她其实没那么有钱，结果反倒得罪了她。

lines.en: : That’s not really something that would offend anyone, Touka. I mean, the majority of the country is in the same financial bracket as Ami and me.
lines.zh: : 这种事其实不会得罪谁啦，Touka。我是说，全国大部分人都跟我和 Ami 是同一个经济档次的。

lines.en: scene nikiami4
: That’s right. We have accepted our place in society as average Joes and Julies and must resort to dreaming about the amount of money you have since we’ll never actually {i}have{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 没错。我们已经接受了自己在社会上当普通 Joe 和普通 Julie 的地位，只能靠幻想你有多少钱过日子，反正我们自己这辈子是别想{i}有那么多{/i}了。

lines.en: : I’m very sad to hear this, but I’m still having trouble understanding how the elephant wound up {i}inside{/i} of the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 听到这些我很伤心，但我还是弄不明白，那头大象最后是怎么进到餐厅{i}里面{/i}去的。

lines.en: : Haha! Classic Ayane.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！Ayane 老样子。

lines.en: : That girl's going to walk into the wrong fast food place one day.
lines.zh: : 那丫头迟早有一天会走错快餐店的。

lines.en: : Just kidding. She already did that.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。她已经走错了。

lines.en: : I tried to make a joke but it sounded more like I wasn’t paying attention. I am.
lines.zh: : 我本来想讲个笑话，结果听起来更像是我根本没在听。我其实有在听。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, everyone.
lines.zh: : 对不起，各位。

lines.en: scene nikiami5
: Otoha, where did you get your swimsuit? I really like it.
lines.zh: : Otoha，你这件泳衣哪儿买的？我好喜欢。

lines.en: : Uhh...Amazon? I don’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 呃……Amazon？我不太记得了。

lines.en: : Are you just saying that because we’ve already name dropped Taco Bell and DoorDash and this is the product placement event?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是因为我们已经提到了 Taco Bell 和 DoorDash，而这又是植入广告环节，才这么说的吧？

lines.en: : What? No. Of course not.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。当然不是。

lines.en: scene nikiami6
: Oh, look. Here comes Maya.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。Maya 来了。

lines.en: scene nikiami7
: Hey, guys.
lines.zh: : 嘿，各位。

lines.en: : Princess Maya! What are you up to this fine morning?
lines.zh: : Maya 公主！这么美好的早晨，你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Just enjoying the crisp, refreshing taste of a Coca Cola.
lines.zh: : 只是在享受一杯可口可乐那清爽怡人的味道。

lines.en: : How about you?
lines.zh: : 你们呢？

lines.en: : We’re trying to figure out which store Otoha got her swimsuit from.
lines.zh: : 我们在猜 Otoha 的泳衣是从哪家店买的。

lines.en: : I’m not really participating in any way. I’m supposed to stay out of product placement because it won’t be good for my image if I make it in the future.
lines.zh: : 我其实完全没参与。我本来就该远离植入广告，因为我要是以后的路走得成，这样对形象不好。

lines.en: : That’s really depressing.
lines.zh: : 那可真够丧的。

lines.en: : But what’s not depressing is the taste of an ice cold Coca Cola after a long day of work or[school].
lines.zh: : 但在上了一整天班或者 [school] 之后，来一口冰镇可口可乐，那味道可一点都不丧。

lines.en: scene nikiami8
: Coca Cola.
lines.zh: : 可口可乐。

lines.en: scene nikiami7
: Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: : 总之，拜。

lines.en: scene nikiami9
: Yeah, so I’m pretty sure I just got it off Amazon.
lines.zh: : 嗯，所以我很确定就是在 Amazon 上买的。

lines.en: : Neat!
lines.zh: : 不错嘛！

lines.en: : Hey...you went out with Rin after D&D last night, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 对了……昨晚 D&D 之后你跟 Rin 出去了，对吧？

lines.en: scene nikiami10
: Hm? Yeah, right before we went back to our rooms. We didn’t really do anything, though. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 嗯？对，就在我们回房间之前。不过我们其实没干什么，怎么了？

lines.en: : Oh. I was just wondering how things went since...Nodoka told me you thought she might have been avoiding you.
lines.zh: : 哦。我只是想知道后来怎么样了，因为……Nodoka 跟我说，你觉得她可能一直在躲着你。

lines.en: scene nikiami11
: Oh! Yeah. I...think that’s over with now?
lines.zh: : 哦！对。我……觉得那事现在已经过去了？

lines.en: : Was just kinda confused since she’s never done anything like that before.
lines.zh: : 就是有点纳闷，因为她以前从没这样过。

lines.en: : I'm pretty sure it was just a weird morning. And...however long she was doing it before that for.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定那只是个奇怪的早晨。而且……在那之前她已经这么干了多久了。

lines.en: : It was probably several weird mornings.
lines.zh: : 大概是好几个奇怪的早晨吧。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m glad everything is okay, though.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过我很高兴一切都好了。

lines.en: : You two made plans for...tonight, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你们俩约了……今晚，对吧？

lines.en: scene nikiami12
: Uhh...I think so?...
lines.zh: : 呃……应该是吧？……

lines.en: : But she kind of just ran off as soon as I agreed so...can only imagine what that was about.
lines.zh: : 不过我刚答应下来她就跑了，所以……她到底在想什么，我只能自己猜了。

lines.en: scene nikiami13
: Have I mentioned at all this morning how much I hate the two of you and want you to die?
lines.zh: : 我今天早上说过没有，我有多讨厌你们两个、有多想让你们去死？

lines.en: scene nikiami14
: Yes. Several times on the way to the table. And when we passed that one palm tree that looked like a hockey stick. And then again when we sat down.
lines.zh: : 说过。走向桌子那会儿说了好几次。路过那棵长得像曲棍球棒的棕榈树的时候又说了一次。然后坐下的时候又来了一遍。

lines.en: : I recall the last instance, but this is the first time our deaths have been associated with it.
lines.zh: : 最后一次我倒是记得，不过这还是第一次把我们的死活跟它扯上关系。

lines.en: : Do you really desire large breasts so badly that it drives you to despising those who possess them?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么渴望拥有丰满的胸部，以至于讨厌起拥有它们的人吗？

lines.en: : Whaaaat? Meeeee? Noooooo. Meeeee?
lines.zh: : 啥——啊？我——吗？才——没有。我——吗？

lines.en: scene nikiami15
: You...are really pretty though, Touka.
lines.zh: : 你……真的好漂亮啊，Touka。

lines.en: : Like...not just your breasts. But the...whole Touka...thing...
lines.zh: : 就是……不只是胸部。是那个……整个 Touka……的感觉……

lines.en: : Oh my.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : Karin...you aren’t flirting with me, are you? Because I’ve not yet trained myself on how to properly reject a woman- let alone one that’s also my senpai.
lines.zh: : Karin……你该不会是在跟我调情吧？因为我还没练过该怎么得体地拒绝一个女人——更别说对方还是我的 Senpai。

lines.en: scene nikiami16
: Why do I even talk when everything I say comes out as...words?
lines.zh: : 我干嘛还要开口说话啊，说出来的全是……话。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Karin! You’ll get there soon enough!
lines.zh: : 别担心，Karin！你很快就可以了！

lines.en: : What I used to do to prepare myself for saying cute things to Sensei was saying them to stuffed animals first!
lines.zh: : 我以前为了能对 Sensei 说出可爱的话，会先对着毛绒玩具练！

lines.en: : Then, once I was able to do it with my eyes closed, I’d go say it to him.
lines.zh: : 然后，等我能闭着眼睛说出来了，就去对他说。

lines.en: : It never worked so this probably isn’t great advice, but I’m sure you get what I’m trying to say.
lines.zh: : 反正一直都没成功过，所以这大概算不上什么好建议，不过我相信你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : My, how peculiar.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，真是奇特。

lines.en: : I do believe there is a famous pop musician who just joined us at the table.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，刚刚有位著名的流行歌手加入了我们的桌子。

lines.en: scene nikiami17
: Touka...I don’t know how else to say this, so I’m just going to be blunt.
lines.zh: : Touka……我不知道该怎么说才好，我就直说了。

lines.en: : Your high class jokes don’t really work on us...{i}normal{/i} people.
lines.zh: : 你那些上流社会的笑话，对我们这些……{i}普通{/i}人不太管用。

lines.en: : You can’t just say “Oh look, there’s a thing here that isn’t {i}actually{/i} there,” because that’s more like a...prank than a joke.
lines.zh: : 你不能就这么说「哦瞧，这儿有个{i}其实{/i}并不存在的东西」，因为那更像是……恶作剧，而不是笑话。

lines.en: : And even then, it’s just...not all that funny.
lines.zh: : 而且就算那样，也……没那么好笑。

lines.en: : Oh my God. Niki Nakayama is right behind you.
lines.zh: : 我的天。Niki Nakayama 就在你背后。

lines.en: : See? It’s just not funny at all. And thanks for the example, Karin.
lines.zh: : 瞧？一点都不好笑吧。谢了，还给我举例，Karin。

lines.en: : No...Ami, I do believe she is, in fact, right behind you.
lines.zh: : 不……Ami，我敢说她确实就在你背后。

lines.en: : She’s looking right at you.
lines.zh: : 她正盯着你看呢。

lines.en: : Poor Chika...sleeping in on the day her favorite artist shows up to breakfast.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Chika……她最喜欢的歌手来吃早饭的日子，她居然在睡懒觉。

lines.en: scene nikiami18
: Guys, I’m not going to fall for it.
lines.zh: : 各位，我不会上当的。

lines.en: : I might not {i}look{/i} mature, but I can guarantee you that there’s no way I’m gullible enough to believe that the queen of everything, Niki Nakayama, my all time favorite non-Sensei human, is at our table.
lines.zh: : 我{i}看{/i}着可能不成熟，但我敢保证，我绝对没有轻信到会相信这种事——万事女王 Niki Nakayama，我这一生最喜欢的非 Sensei 人类，正站在我们桌边。

lines.en: : You think {i}Niki{/i} would come to this beach? Are you insane?
lines.zh: : 你们觉得 {i}Niki{/i} 会来这片海滩？你们疯了吗？

lines.en: : Sure, she might be Noriko’s older sister, but there’s no way Noriko would be able to convince her to come waste her time on {i}us{/i} when she has so many better things to do.
lines.zh: : 没错，她可能是 Noriko 的姐姐，但 Noriko 绝不可能说服她浪费时间在{i}我们{/i}身上，她明明有那么多更重要的事要做。

lines.en: scene nikiami19
: Yo. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哟。你来这儿干嘛？

lines.en: : Is this...
lines.zh: : 这是……

lines.en: : Is this real?
lines.zh: : 这是真的吗？
: Ami……我……

lines.en: : I think you better turn around...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你最好还是转过身去……

lines.en: : You too, Futaba? Come on. I’m not-
lines.zh: : 连你也这样，Futaba？拜托。我又不是——

lines.en: : {i}*Ahem*{/i}
: Surprise! I brought a pop star!
lines.zh: : 惊喜！我带了个流行歌星来！

lines.en: : Noriko, you didn’t-
lines.zh: : Noriko，你该不会——

lines.en: scene nikiami20
: AAAAAAAHHHHHHHHH! YOU REALLY ARE HERE!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！你真的在这儿！

lines.en: Ami jumps out of her seat at the picnic table and stands before who I guess is her role model.
lines.zh: Ami 从野餐桌的座位上蹦起来，站到了我猜应该是她榜样的人面前。

lines.en: Little does Ami know, her role model is actually a conniving and evil pink demon who thinks the world should bow before her because she knows how to dance or something.
lines.zh: Ami 还不知道，她的榜样其实是个阴险邪恶的粉色恶魔，觉得自己会跳舞什么的，全世界就该在她面前跪下。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: Niki isn’t that bad. She just calls me mean things a lot.
lines.zh: Niki 也没那么坏。她只是经常用很难听的话骂我。

lines.en: But so does Maya and I still talk to her.
lines.zh: 可 Maya 也这样，我还是照样跟她说话。

lines.en: And Yumi.
lines.zh: 还有 Yumi。

lines.en: And Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 还有 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: And Wakana and Osako.
lines.zh: 还有 Wakana 和 Osako。

lines.en: Wait, why are so many girls mean to me?
lines.zh: 等等，为什么这么多女生都对我很凶？

lines.en: Am I actually unpopular with women?
lines.zh: 我真的这么不受女生待见吗？

lines.en: : Hi, Ami.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Ami。

lines.en: : You’ve gotten so tall.
lines.zh: : 你长这么高了。

lines.en: : Well...comparatively. You weren’t even really human sized the last time I saw you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……相对来说吧。上次我见到你的时候，你都还算不上人的尺寸。

lines.en: scene nikiami21
: You...saw me and...I don’t remember it?
lines.zh: : 你……见过我，而我……不记得了？

lines.en: : You were just a little kid back then. I can’t even remember how old.
lines.zh: : 那时候你还只是个小孩子。我都记不清你几岁。

lines.en: : She was also at the diner when you were there for the D&D thing.
lines.zh: : 你们搞 D&D 那次她也在餐厅，跟你在同一个地方。

lines.en: : If I knew it was this big of a deal, I would have just introduced you back then.
lines.zh: : 我要是知道这事这么重要，当时就直接给你介绍了。

lines.en: scene nikiami22
: You knew Ami was at the diner and you didn’t introduce me?!
lines.zh: : 你知道 Ami 在餐厅，居然不给我介绍？！

lines.en: : You knew Niki was at the diner and you didn’t introduce me?!
lines.zh: : 你知道 Niki 在餐厅，居然不给我介绍？！

lines.en: : Jeez. There’s no need to be dramatic. I didn’t realize it was that big of a thing.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。没必要这么夸张。我当时没意识到这事有这么大。

lines.en: : You {i}know{/i} I love Niki! She’s the only girl I’d share you with!
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}我有多爱 Niki 的！她是唯一一个我愿意跟你分享的女生！

lines.en: scene nikiami23
: You don’t have to worry about that. Your [uncle] and I broke up a really long time ago. Before you two...even...
lines.zh: : 这个你不用担心。你 [uncle] 和我早就分手了。早在你俩……甚至……

lines.en: scene nikiami24
: You know what? Let’s not even talk about that. Can I have a hug?
lines.zh: : 知道吗？这个我们先别聊了。能给我个拥抱吗？

lines.en: : You...you’re asking...{i}me{/i} for a hug?...
lines.zh: : 你……你在问……{i}我{/i}要拥抱？……

lines.en: : But...but you’re...an angel...and I’m just...
lines.zh: : 可……可你是……天使……而我只是……

lines.en: : An adorable [young_girl] who I’ve wanted to see again for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 一个可爱的 [young_girl]，而且我盼着再见你一面，盼了很久很久。

lines.en: scene nikiami25
: This can’t be real...
lines.zh: : 这不可能是真的……

lines.en: : Hug my friggin’ sister, Ami. She’s waited years for this moment!
lines.zh: : 抱一下我那该死的姐姐啊，Ami。她为这一刻等了好多年了！

lines.en: : We should probably tell Niki that Ami very likely won’t ever let go. It’s hard enough for {i}me{/i} to get her off and she doesn’t sing any of my songs while she’s in the bath.
lines.zh: : 我们大概该提醒 Niki 一下，Ami 很可能会死活不撒手。光是让她从{i}我{/i}身上下来就已经够费劲的了，而且她在浴缸里的时候也不会唱我的歌。

lines.en: : I was unaware you had songs, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道你也有歌呢，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, now I guess you’ll have to come to my next band practice.
lines.zh: : 是嘛，那现在你大概得来我下次的乐队排练看看了。

lines.en: : They’re kind of ruining the moment, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 她们挺会破坏气氛的，对吧？

lines.en: : I’m still...trying to figure out if...I’m going to wake up or not...
lines.zh: : 我还在……琢磨自己到底……会不会醒过来……

lines.en: scene nikiami26
: So...that rumor was...actually true?
lines.zh: : 所以……那个传闻是……真的？

lines.en: : Sensei...dated Niki?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……跟 Niki 交往过？……

lines.en: : {i}The{/i} Niki?...
lines.zh: : {i}那个{/i} Niki？……

lines.en: : I didn’t believe it at first either, but...yup.
lines.zh: : 我一开始也不信，不过……嗯。

lines.en: : She still talks about him all the time, too.
lines.zh: : 而且她到现在还整天提起他。

lines.en: : Granted, it’s in a pretty horrible way since all she does is complain...but they definitely dated.
lines.zh: : 虽说提的方式挺难听的，因为她除了抱怨还是抱怨……但他们确实交往过。

lines.en: : {size=-15}Great...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}好极了……{/size}

lines.en: scene nikiami27
: Well...I guess my self-confidence was bound to vanish again soon enough.
lines.zh: : 唉……看来我的自信心迟早还是要消失的。

lines.en: : Dude, no. You’re great. Don’t go letting this drag you down just because Niki has depressingly poor taste in guys.
lines.zh: : 别这样，姐们。你很棒。别因为 Niki 挑男人的眼光烂得让人沮丧，就把自己给拖下水。

lines.en: : Hey. I heard that.
lines.zh: : 喂。我听见了。

lines.en: scene nikiami28
: It must have been hard having to take care of your [uncle] for all those years, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么多年都是你在照顾你 [uncle]，一定很辛苦吧？

lines.en: : I can’t believe...this is happening...
lines.zh: : 我不敢相信……这居然是真的……

lines.en: : You did a great job, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你做得很好，Ami。

lines.en: : Even if he’s a horrible human being who left me on my own until just recently.
lines.zh: : 就算他是个糟糕透顶的人，直到最近都一直把我丢在一边不管。

lines.en: : And then ditched me to come to the beach with my little sister.
lines.zh: : 然后又抛下我，跟我妹妹来海边。

lines.en: : And never told me that we were literally right next to each other and that this reunion took much longer to happen than it had to.
lines.zh: : 还从来没告诉我，我们其实就在彼此隔壁，硬是让这次重逢拖了那么久才发生，明明根本不用等这么久。

lines.en: : But besides all of that, you did great.
lines.zh: : 不过除了这些，你做得很好。

lines.en: : You can cry as much as you want.
lines.zh: : 你想哭多久就哭多久。

lines.en: scene nikiami29
: {i}*Sniff*{/i}
: Can you...move in with us?...
lines.zh: : 你能不能……搬来跟我们一起住？……

lines.en: : Um...I don’t think that’s a very good idea.
lines.zh: : 呃……我觉得这主意不太妙。

lines.en: scene nikiami30
: But if your asshole [uncle] wants to finally tell me where he’s been hiding out all these years, I’d be happy to come over and see {i}you{/i} whenever I can!
lines.zh: : 不过如果{i}你{/i}那个混蛋 [uncle] 终于愿意告诉我他这些年一直躲在哪儿，我很乐意一有空就过去看你！

lines.en: : And let me clarify! I mean {i}you{/i}, Ami! Not him!
lines.zh: : 我先声明！我说的是{i}你{/i}，Ami！不是他！

lines.en: scene nikiami31
: {i}Ooooooooh...you’re in troooooouble...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦——哦——哦……你要有——麻烦了……{/i}

lines.en: : I’m pretty much always in trouble. It has become a staple of my everyday life.
lines.zh: : 我基本上一直都有麻烦。这已经成了我日常生活的基本配置。

lines.en: : But that’s just how things work when everyone around you falls in love with you.
lines.zh: : 不过身边所有人都爱上你的时候，事情本来就是这样。

lines.en: scene nikiami32
: Guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Those two are cute, though, huh?
lines.zh: : 不过她俩挺可爱的，对吧？

lines.en: : It’s almost like Niki would rather have Ami as a sister than me.
lines.zh: : 感觉 Niki 都恨不得把 Ami 当妹妹，而不是我了。

lines.en: : Seems like she’s playing more of a mother role right now.
lines.zh: : 看样子她现在更像是在扮演母亲的角色。

lines.en: : She really did worry, you know. I wasn’t kidding about that.
lines.zh: : 她是真的担心过，你知道的。那件事我没开玩笑。

lines.en: : I did too, of course. But it’s not like I was really old enough to remember {i}that{/i} much about Ami.
lines.zh: : 我当然也担心。不过{i}那{/i}时候我还小，关于 Ami 的事记不太清。

lines.en: : I just always used to hear Nee-chan talking about you two...hoping that you two were able to be there for each other because you wouldn’t let us be there for you.
lines.zh: : 我只是总听见姐念叨你们俩……希望你们俩能互相扶持，因为你不肯让我们陪在你身边。

lines.en: : That wasn’t fair, you know.
lines.zh: : 那不公平，你知道吗。

lines.en: : I understand that Ami’s your family...but you had more family than that. You had us.
lines.zh: : 我理解 Ami 是你的家人……可你的家人不止她一个。你还有我们。

lines.en: : We were little angels back then.
lines.zh: : 那时候我们还是小天使呢。

lines.en: : And if you played your cards right and waited until I was developed and stuff, I probably could have talked Nee-chan into a threesome. Lord knows I was ready for it.
lines.zh: : 而且你要是打得一手好牌、一直等到我发育好了什么的，我说不定还能说服姐来个三人行。天知道我那时候早就准备好了。

lines.en: : Oh. I thought this was going to be a sentimental moment. Now I’m just turned on.
lines.zh: : 哦。我还以为这会是个煽情的时刻呢。现在我倒是来劲了。

lines.en: scene nikiami33
: Whoops~
lines.zh: : 哎呀~

lines.en: : Really, though. I’m glad we could be here to see this.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我很高兴我们能在这儿见证这一幕。

lines.en: : But aaaaaafterwards...if you’d want to go back to the inn-
lines.zh: : 不过之——后……如果你想回旅馆的话——

lines.en: scene nikiami34
: NORIKO! GET YOUR STUPID FUCKING HEAD OFF OF HIS STUPID FUCKING SHOULDER!
lines.zh: : NORIKO！把你那该死的蠢脑袋从他那该死的蠢肩膀上挪开！

lines.en: : What?! You’re interrupting my seduction!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你打断我的勾引了！

lines.en: : Did...Did Niki just curse?...
lines.zh: : 刚……Niki 刚刚是不是骂人了？……

lines.en: : Is she allowed to do that?
lines.zh: : 她可以说这种话吗？

lines.en: : Oh man. You guys have no idea...
lines.zh: : 哦天哪。你们根本不懂……

lines.en: scene black
Niki manages to break apart from Ami much easier than I thought she’d be able to before making her way over to Noriko and demanding that she help her with her shoot.
lines.zh: Niki 从 Ami 怀里脱身，比我预想的要容易得多，随后她走到 Noriko 身边，要求她去给自己当拍摄的帮手。

lines.en: Being unable to refuse as her sister’s part time employee or...helper or whatever Noriko’s unofficial title is, she submits and vanishes shortly after.
lines.zh: 作为她妹妹的兼职雇员或者……助手，姑且不管 Noriko 那个非正式头衔到底叫什么，她没法拒绝，只好乖乖听话，很快就消失了。

lines.en: The rest of the girls disperse, but Ami remains standing in the exact place where she and Niki separated.
lines.zh: 其余的女生都散开了，只有 Ami 还站在她和 Niki 分开时的那个位置上一动不动。

lines.en: I look down to see her clasping something in her hands and, to my surprise, it’s a business card.
lines.zh: 我低头看去，只见她手里紧紧攥着什么东西，让我意外的是，那是一张名片。

lines.en: However, I notice that it is distinctly different from the one she handed {i}me{/i} when we first “reunited,” confirming that Niki actually {i}is{/i} a demon and likes my [niece] more than me.
lines.zh: 不过我注意到，这张和{i}我{/i}们初次「重逢」时她递给我的那张明显不一样，这就证实了 Niki {i}真的{/i}是个恶魔，而且她喜欢我的 [niece] 胜过喜欢我。

lines.en: : Are you going to call her?
lines.zh: : 你要打给她吗？

lines.en: : ...Can I?
lines.zh: : ……可以吗？

lines.en: : You can do whatever you want. Just know that she’s really busy most of the time.
lines.zh: : 你想做什么都行。只是你要知道，她大部分时间都很忙。

lines.en: : Sorry, Sensei...but I’m gonna go wash my face...I think I cried a little too much.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sensei……不过我要去洗把脸……我觉得自己哭得有点太狠了。

lines.en: : Hm? Oh, sure. I’ll just...see you later then, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，当然。那我就……回头再见吧，我想。

lines.en: Ami takes off as well, leaving me alone on the sand despite knowing a grand total of twenty-four girls on the beach right now.
lines.zh: Ami 也跑掉了，把我一个人留在沙滩上，尽管此时此刻这片海滩上我总共认识二十四个女生。

lines.en: I guess it’s a big beach, though. So I’m bound to run into-
lines.zh: 不过我想这片海滩挺大的。所以我迟早会撞上——

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: $ secondbeach13 = True
See what I mean?
lines.zh: 明白我意思了吧？
